standard: IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.14.4 (Syntax 11-5): a stream expression may be a one-dimensional unpacked array followed by with [array_range_expression]; in a pack it behaves as an array slice, only the specified items are streamed, and items outside the array are the nonexistent-entry value of Table 7-1 (7.4.5), 0 for byte. So {>>{up with [1 +: 2]}} streams up[1] and up[2], {>>{down with [4:2]}} of byte down [3:0] streams 0, down[3] and down[2], and the 32-bit target is padded with zero bits on the right (11.4.14).
method: The shared case runs unchanged in verify-sv-verilator, verify-sv-icarus and verify-sv-xezim; the reduced source below runs without the adapters.
